title: Crab Derby, 2002 · after
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The Monday after: the fifth flyer up, two crabs on it — one's yours — and Wood at the wall pretending not to look at it. Gully looks for both of them.

panels.composition: The wall with five flyers, the newest with two crabs. WOOD beside it not looking. BARNABY.
